STD-016.gsql: ANSI CTE form, portable across warehouses. The table name findings is illustrative — map your own source system. Bind the :parameters; the CASE encodes the fail-closed rule (empty denominator → NULL, never 0).
STD-016.pg: The FILTER aggregate expresses the numerator as a true subset of the denominator in one scan — the subset rule of the card, made structural. PostgreSQL 14+; the same shape works on most modern warehouses.
STD-016.kql: Microsoft Sentinel, Defender or Log Analytics; findings stands for your findings export table. Parameters via let; iff(due == 0, real(null), …) reports n/a, never 0.
STD-016.spl: Splunk; index and sourcetype are illustrative. Timestamps are assumed to be epoch fields; $tokens$ come from dashboard inputs or macros. null() reports n/a, never 0.
STD-016.esql: Elasticsearch 8.14+ with named query parameters (?name); findings stands for your index or data stream. CASE(due == 0, NULL, …) reports n/a, never 0.
STD-016.dax: Power BI measure. Period and scope are shown inline for self-containment — in production the period usually comes from a date-table relationship and slicers. BLANK() reports n/a, never 0.
STD-016.py: pandas; column names follow the card's minimum data fields. A missing remediated_at (NaT) never counts as within SLA. None reports n/a, never 0.

SOC-002.gsql: Concrete duration recipe honoring the card output contract: hours (ttd_h), named outputs valid_cases/p50_h/p90_h/mean_h_supplementary. P50 as the true median (percentile_cont), P90 as the exact nearest rank (percentile_disc) - verified against the card example in the fixture gate. Empty case base returns NULL = n/a, never 0.
SOC-002.pg: percentile_disc returns the exact nearest-rank value and matches the card's P90 method one-to-one. PostgreSQL 14+; invalid cases (missing or negative timestamps) are excluded here and belong in data confidence.
SOC-002.kql: percentile() is a T-digest estimate, not exact nearest rank — on small case bases the difference is nil, for board-grade exactness compute the rank explicitly. Empty case base returns no row = n/a.
SOC-002.spl: Concrete duration recipe: P50 as the true median (lower/upper middle averaged, parity-safe), P90 as an explicit nearest rank via sort/streamstats - engine percentile estimators differ from the card-mandated method (Splunk fixture finding: nearest-rank P50 returned 10 instead of the median 15 for even case counts). Timestamps arrive as epoch seconds. Empty case base returns no results = n/a.
SOC-002.esql: Concrete duration recipe: the P90 is computed as an explicit nearest rank via MV_SORT/MV_SLICE - the engine's PERCENTILE() is a t-digest estimate and returned 26 h instead of the card-mandated 30 h on the reference fixture (verified against a real Elasticsearch in recipe CI). Empty case base returns null aggregates = n/a.
SOC-002.dax: The nearest-rank P90 is built explicitly via ROUNDUP + TOPN, because PERCENTILE.INC interpolates — on the fixture it would return 26 h instead of the correct 30 h. Expose P50 (MEDIANX) and the supplementary mean as sibling measures.
SOC-002.py: Explicit nearest rank (ceil(0.9 · n)) matches the card example. NaT timestamps never count; negative durations are excluded as data-quality errors and belong in data confidence.
